name: Seaglass · Gremlet #49
description:
A piece of sea glass worn smooth by a hundred tides. Glows faintly green in the sun.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Seaglass in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
